title: Commuting graphs of Okubo algebras
summary: Commuting graphs of Okubo algebras are considered, and the problem of their connectivity is studied. The commuting graph of a pseudo-octonion algebra $P_8(\mathbb{F})$ over a field $\mathbb{F}$, $\mathrm{char} \, \mathbb{F} \neq 3$, that contains a primitive cubic root of unity is shown to be isomorphic to the commuting graph of the matrix algebra $M_3(\mathbb{F})$. As a consequence, if the field $\mathbb{F}$ is algebraically closed, then the diameter of the commuting graph for the unique Okubo algebra over $\mathbb{F}$ equals $4$.
